text_en: Now the festival of Unleavened Bread, which is called the Passover, was near.
text_cn: 称为逾越节的无酵节近了。

text_en: The chief priests and the scribes were looking for a way to put Jesus to death, for they were afraid of the people.
text_cn: 司祭长及经师设法要怎样消除耶稣，因为他们害怕百姓。

text_en: Then Satan entered into Judas called Iscariot, who was one of the twelve;
text_cn: 那时，撒殚进入了那名叫依斯加略的犹达斯的心中，他本是十二人中之一。

text_en: he went away and conferred with the chief priests and officers of the temple police about how he might betray him to them.
text_cn: 他去同司祭长及圣殿警官商议，怎样把耶稣交给他们。

text_en: They were greatly pleased and agreed to give him money.
text_cn: 他们不胜欣喜，就约定给他银钱；

text_en: So he consented and began to look for an opportunity to betray him to them when no crowd was present.
text_cn: 他应允了，遂寻找机会，当群众不在的时候，把耶稣交给他们。

text_en: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread, on which the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed.
text_cn: 无酵节日到了，这一天，应宰杀逾越节羔羊。

text_en: So Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover meal for us that we may eat it. ”
text_cn: 耶稣打发伯多禄和若望说：“你们去为我们预备要吃的逾越节晚餐罢！”

text_en: They asked him, “Where do you want us to make preparations for it? ”
text_cn: 他们问他说：“你愿意我们在哪里预备？”

text_en: “Listen, ” he said to them, “when you have entered the city, a man carrying a jar of water will meet you; follow him into the house he enters
text_cn: 他回答说：“注意！你们进城，必有一个拿水罐的人与你们相遇，你们就跟着他，到他所进的那一家，

text_en: and say to the owner of the house, ‘The teacher asks you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples? ”’
text_cn: 对那家的主人说：师傅问你：我同我的门徒吃逾越节晚餐的客房在哪里？

text_en: He will show you a large room upstairs, already furnished. Make preparations for us there. ”
text_cn: 那人必指给你们一间铺设好了的宽大楼厅；你们就在那里准备。”

text_en: So they went and found everything as he had told them; and they prepared the Passover meal.
text_cn: 他们去了，所遇见的，正如耶稣对他们所说的一样；他们便预备了逾越节晚餐。

text_en: When the hour came, he took his place at the table, and the apostles with him.
text_cn: 到了时候，耶稣就入席，宗徒也同他一起。

text_en: He said to them, “I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer;
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“我渴望而又渴望，在我受难以前，同你们吃这一次逾越节晚餐。

text_en: for I tell you, I will not eat it until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God. ”
text_cn: 我告诉你们：非等到它在天主的国里成全了，我决不再吃它。”

text_en: Then he took a cup, and after giving thanks he said, “Take this and divide it among yourselves;
text_cn: 耶稣接过杯来，祝谢了说：“你们把这杯拿去，彼此分着喝罢！

text_en: for I tell you that from now on I will not drink of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes. ”
text_cn: 我告诉你们：从今以后，非等到天主的国来临了，我决不再喝这葡萄汁了。”

text_en: Then he took a loaf of bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body, which is given for you. Do this in remembrance of me. ”
text_cn: 耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了，擘（ bāi）开，递给他们说：“这是我的身体，为你们而舍弃的。你们应行此礼，为纪念我。”

text_en: And he did the same with the cup after supper, saying, “This cup that is poured out for you is the new covenant in my blood.
text_cn: 晚餐以后，耶稣同样拿起杯来，说：“这杯是用我为你们流出的血而立的新约。”

text_en: But see, the one who betrays me is with me, and his hand is on the table.
text_cn: “但是，看，负卖我者的手同我一起在桌子上。

text_en: For the Son of Man is going as it has been determined, but woe to that one by whom he is betrayed! ”
text_cn: 人子固然要依照所预定的离去，但那负卖人子的人是有祸的。”

text_en: Then they began to ask one another which one of them it could be who would do this.
text_cn: 他们便彼此相问，他们中哪一个要做这事。

text_en: A dispute also arose among them as to which one of them was to be regarded as the greatest.
text_cn: 在他们中又起了争论：他们中数着谁最大。

text_en: But he said to them, “The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them; and those in authority over them are called benefactors.
text_cn: 耶稣给他们说：“外邦人有君王宰制他们，那有权管治他们的，称为恩主；

text_en: But not so with you; rather the greatest among you must become like the youngest, and the leader like one who serves.
text_cn: 但你们却不要这样：你们中最大的，要成为最小的；为首领的，要成为服事人的。

text_en: For who is greater, the one who is at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.
text_cn: 是谁大呢？是坐席的，还是服事人的？不是坐席的吗？可是我在你们中间却像是服事人的。

text_en: “You are those who have stood by me in my trials;
text_cn: 在我的困难中，与我常常相偕的，就是你们。

text_en: and I confer on you, just as my Father has conferred on me, a kingdom,
text_cn: 所以，我将王权给你们预备下，正如我父给我预备下了一样，

text_en: so that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and you will sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
text_cn: 为使你们在我的国里，一同在我的筵席上吃喝，并坐在宝座上，审判以色列十二支派。

text_en: “Simon, Simon, listen! Satan has demanded to sift all of you like wheat,
text_cn: 西满，西满，看，撒殚求得了许可，要筛你们像筛麦子一样。

text_en: but I have prayed for you that your own faith may not fail; and you, when once you have turned back, strengthen your brothers. ”
text_cn: 但是我已为你祈求了，为叫你的信德不至丧失，待你回头以后，要坚固你的兄弟。”

text_en: And he said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you to prison and to death! ”
text_cn: 伯多禄向他说：“主，我已经准备同你一起下狱，同去受死。”

text_en: Jesus said, “I tell you, Peter, the cock will not crow this day, until you have denied three times that you know me. ”
text_cn: 耶稣说：“伯多禄，我告诉你：今天鸡还未叫以前，你要三次说不认识我。”

text_en: He said to them, “When I sent you out without a purse, bag, or sandals, did you lack anything? ” They said, “No, not a thing. ”
text_cn: 然后又给他们说：“我以前派遣你们的时候，没有带钱囊、口袋及鞋，你们缺少了什么没有？”他们说：“什么也没有缺。”

text_en: He said to them, “But now, the one who has a purse must take it, and likewise a bag. And the one who has no sword must sell his cloak and buy one.
text_cn: 耶稣向他们说：“可是如今，有钱囊的，应当带着；有口袋的也一样；没有剑的，应当卖去自己的外衣，去买一把。

text_en: For I tell you, this scripture must be fulfilled in me, ‘And he was counted among the lawless’; and indeed what is written about me is being fulfilled. ”
text_cn: 我告诉你们：经上所载：‘他被列于叛逆之中’的这句话，必须应验在我身上，因为那有关我的事，快要终结。”

text_en: They said, “Lord, look, here are two swords. ” He replied, “It is enough. ”
text_cn: 他们说：“主，看，这里有两把剑。”耶稣给他们说：“够了！”

text_en: He came out and went, as was his custom, to the Mount of Olives; and the disciples followed him.
text_cn: 耶稣出来，照常往橄榄山去，门徒也跟他去了。

text_en: When he reached the place, he said to them, “Pray that you may not come into the time of trial. ”
text_cn: 到了那地方，耶稣便给他们说：“你们应当祈祷，免得陷于诱惑。”

text_en: Then he withdrew from them about a stone’s throw, knelt down, and prayed,
text_cn: 遂离开他们，约有投石那么远，屈膝祈祷，

text_en: “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me; yet, not my will but yours be done. ” [[
text_cn: 说：“父啊！你如果愿意，请给我免去这杯罢！但不要随我的意愿，惟照你的意愿成就罢！”

text_en: Then an angel from heaven appeared to him and gave him strength.
text_cn: 有一位天使，从天上显现给他，加强他的力量。

text_en: In his anguish he prayed more earnestly, and his sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground. ]]
text_cn: 他在极度恐慌中，祈祷越发恳切；他的汗如同血珠滴在地上。

text_en: When he got up from prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,
text_cn: 他从祈祷中起来，到门徒那里，看见他们都因忧闷睡着了，

text_en: and he said to them, “Why are you sleeping? Get up and pray that you may not come into the time of trial. ”
text_cn: 就给他们说：“你们怎么睡觉呢？起来祈祷罢！免得陷于诱惑。”

text_en: While he was still speaking, suddenly a crowd came, and the one called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He approached Jesus to kiss him;
text_cn: 耶稣还说话的时候，来了一群人，那十二人之一，名叫犹达斯的，走在他们前面；他走近了耶稣，要口亲他。

text_en: but Jesus said to him, “Judas, is it with a kiss that you are betraying the Son of Man? ”
text_cn: 耶稣给他说：“犹达斯，你用口亲来负卖人子吗？”

text_en: When those who were around him saw what was coming, they asked, “Lord, should we strike with the sword? ”
text_cn: 耶稣左右的人一见要发生的事，就说：“主，我们可以用剑砍吗？”

text_en: Then one of them struck the slave of the high priest and cut off his right ear.
text_cn: 他们中有一个人砍了大司祭的仆人，把他的右耳削了下来。

text_en: But Jesus said, “No more of this! ” And he touched his ear and healed him.
text_cn: 耶稣说道：“至此为止！”就摸了摸那人的耳朵，治好了他。

text_en: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, the officers of the temple police, and the elders who had come for him, “Have you come out with swords and clubs as if I were a bandit?
text_cn: 耶稣对那些来到他跟前的司祭长，和圣殿警官并长老说：“你们拿着刀剑棍棒出来，好像对付强盗吗？

text_en: When I was with you day after day in the temple, you did not lay hands on me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness! ”
text_cn: 我天天同你们在圣殿里的时候，你们没有下手拿我；但现在是你们的时候，是黑暗的权势！”

text_en: Then they seized him and led him away, bringing him into the high priest’s house. But Peter was following at a distance.
text_cn: 他们既拿住耶稣，就带着解到大司祭的住宅。伯多禄远远地跟着。

text_en: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat among them.
text_cn: 他们在庭院中间生了火，一起环坐，伯多禄也坐在他们中间。

text_en: Then a servant-girl, seeing him in the firelight, stared at him and said, “This man also was with him. ”
text_cn: 有一个使女看见他面对火光坐着，便定睛注视他说：“这个人也是同他一起的。”

text_en: But he denied it, saying, “Woman, I do not know him. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄否认说：“女人，我不认识他。”

text_en: A little later someone else, on seeing him, said, “You also are one of them. ” But Peter said, “Man, I am not! ”
text_cn: 过了不久，另一个人看见他说：“你也是他们中的。”伯多禄说：“你这个人！我不是。”

text_en: Then about an hour later still another kept insisting, “Surely this man also was with him; for he is a Galilean. ”
text_cn: 约隔一个时辰，又有一个人肯定说：“这个人，确是同他一起的，因为他是加里肋亚人。”

text_en: But Peter said, “Man, I do not know what you are talking about! ” At that moment, while he was still speaking, the cock crowed.
text_cn: 伯多禄说：“你这个人！我不懂你说的。”他还说话的时候，鸡便叫了。

text_en: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said to him, “Before the cock crows today, you will deny me three times. ”
text_cn: 主转过身来，看了看伯多禄；伯多禄就想起主对他说的话来：“今天鸡叫以前，你要三次不认我。”

text_en: And he went out and wept bitterly.
text_cn: 伯多禄一到外面，就凄惨地哭起来。

text_en: Now the men who were holding Jesus began to mock him and beat him;
text_cn: 那些羁押耶稣的人戏弄他、打他；

text_en: they also blindfolded him and kept asking him, “Prophesy! Who is it that struck you? ”
text_cn: 又蒙起他来，问他说：“你猜一猜：是谁打你？”

text_en: They kept heaping many other insults on him.
text_cn: 他们还说了许多别的侮辱他的话。

text_en: When day came, the assembly of the elders of the people, both chief priests and scribes, gathered together, and they brought him to their council.
text_cn: 天一亮，民间长老及司祭长并经师集合起来，把耶稣带到他们的公议会里，

text_en: They said, “If you are the Messiah, tell us. ” He replied, “If I tell you, you will not believe;
text_cn: 说：“如果你是默西亚，就告诉我们罢！”耶稣回答他们说：“即便我告诉你们，你们也不会相信。

text_en: and if I question you, you will not answer.
text_cn: 如果我问，你们也决不回答。

text_en: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God. ”
text_cn: 从今以后，人子要坐在大能者天主的右边。”

text_en: All of them asked, “Are you, then, the Son of God? ” He said to them, “You say that I am. ”
text_cn: 众人于是说：“那么，你就是天主子了？”耶稣对他们说：“你们说了，我就是。”

text_en: Then they said, “What further testimony do we need? We have heard it ourselves from his own lips! ”
text_cn: 他们说：“我们何必还需要见证呢？我们亲自从他的口中听见了。”
